// An asymmetric-frustum (off-axis) camera: an eye point plus an arbitrary
// projection rectangle in world space. Serves head-tracked displays, CAVEs,
// portals, and tiled display walls.
type OffAxisCamera
    implements IValue
{
    Eye: Point3D;
    Screen: ProjectionPlane;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}
